verdict.rationale: Jira's docs show it can break work into tasks and assign them to people, and hands-on users describe assigning tickets to teammates (one notes a ticket can't be assigned to more than one person). Nothing in the pack explicitly documents setting due dates on tasks; the calendar and timeline views only imply it. missing for 10: explicit due-date field documentation, documented manual task-creation and assignment flow (current docs lean on Rovo AI), multi-assignee support.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can create tasks and assign them to teammates with due dates

citations.quote: Breakdown big ideas into actionable tasks and automatically assign them to the right person with Rovo AI.
